library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: This artifact only ships org.springframework.boot.micrometer.metrics.test.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureMetrics and MetricsContextCustomizerFactory (+ nested DisableMetricsExportContextCustomizer). Without @AutoConfigureMetrics on a @SpringBootTest class, the customizer forces metrics export off for that test context; with it present, CompositeMeterRegistryAutoConfiguration/MetricsAutoConfiguration/SimpleMetricsExportAutoConfiguration/ObservationAutoConfiguration are auto-imported so a MeterRegistry (e.g. SimpleMeterRegistry) is actually registered. A meaningful test pair is: (1) a minimal @SpringBootTest WITHOUT the annotation asserting no usable MeterRegistry bean / metrics export is suppressed, and (2) one WITH @AutoConfigureMetrics asserting a MeterRegistry bean is present and records a meter. The underlying toggle is the plain Spring Boot property spring.test.metrics.export (default false, from spring-configuration-metadata.json) — this is ordinary @SpringBootTest(properties=...) test code, not host environment/system-property setup, so it does not need a deterministic_setup entry.
risks: This is the first 'real' artifact in the spring-boot-*-test family to be onboarded here — its sibling POM-only starters (e.g. spring-boot-starter-micrometer-metrics-test) are already marked not-for-native-image with this artifact as the replacement, but there's no prior PR in this repo for a sibling like spring-boot-webmvc-test/spring-boot-restclient-test to cross-check the exact test shape against.
library_preparation_preflight.summary: Pure test-support SPI module (one annotation + one ContextCustomizerFactory, registered via bundled META-INF/spring.factories). All classes it activates (MetricsAutoConfiguration, SimpleMetricsExportAutoConfiguration, CompositeMeterRegistryAutoConfiguration, ObservationAutoConfiguration) are already transitive compile dependencies via spring-boot-micrometer-metrics and spring-boot-micrometer-observation, declared on this artifact's own POM alongside spring-boot-test-autoconfigure and micrometer-observation-test. No Docker, external service, or environment/system property is required — it's an in-process Spring test-context customizer with zero network or native-OS surface.
